'''BLL1''' was a [[CLL-M2 binary loadlifter/Legends|CLL-M2 binary loadlifter]] who worked for [[Oridelve Incorporated]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gavos]]. During the [[Gavos Droid Revolution]], [[EV-8D3]], figurehead of the [[New Droids' Rights Movement]], used protocols to control him.
